{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_customers = sales[sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Print the number of loyal customers
print(len(loyal_customers))

# Calculate conversion fraction
conversion_fraction = loyal_customers['converted'].mean()

# Print the conversion fraction
print(conversion_fraction)"}
